employer.headline: What's new for employers
employer.intro: A plain-language log of what's changed in JobGiga — newest first.

assistantUpgrade.title: A much more capable assistant
assistantUpgrade.item1: Replies now appear word by word, and you can see what it's doing, like "Searching applicants…". Press Stop at any time.
assistantUpgrade.item2: Full answers when you need them, with tables, headings and lists. Ask it to compare applicants and recommend who to interview, draft an email, or work through a problem.
assistantUpgrade.item3: It can search the web for things like market salaries or labour law, and links its sources.
assistantUpgrade.item4: Attach a PDF, Word or text file, such as a job description or resume, and ask about it. You can also paste longer text.
assistantUpgrade.item5: Regenerate a reply, or edit your last message and try again.
assistantUpgrade.item6: Almost everything on your dashboard now works from chat, too: AI interviews, booking ads, generating posters, submitting a posting for review, screening questions, your company details, logo and files, your profile, Top Matches settings and switching company.
assistantUpgrade.item7: Nothing changes until you press Confirm. Anything that needs a file lets you pick it right on the card.

offersTeamCompany.title: Offers, hiring, your team and company details in chat
offersTeamCompany.item1: Ask who has an offer, which offers have been waiting a while, who you've hired, and how many openings are really left on each job.
offersTeamCompany.item2: Make an offer, confirm a hire or withdraw an offer by asking. The card warns you first if it would over-fill the job, or if the candidate needs to hear from you directly.
offersTeamCompany.item3: Owners and admins can see the team, invite someone, change a role, remove a teammate, re-send an invite and assign jobs to a hiring manager from chat.
offersTeamCompany.item4: Owners and admins can also update company details like your description, website, contact details, benefits and dress code.
offersTeamCompany.item5: Nothing changes until you press Confirm.

interviewsEvaluations.title: Schedule interviews, run evaluations and draft job postings from chat
interviewsEvaluations.item1: Ask the assistant to schedule, reschedule or cancel an interview — it shows you exactly what it's about to send before anything happens, and nothing changes until you confirm.
interviewsEvaluations.item2: Interviewers can submit their evaluation and recommendation straight from the chat, too.
interviewsEvaluations.item3: Describe a role and the assistant drafts a complete job posting for you — it's saved as a draft only, so you still review and publish it yourself.
interviewsEvaluations.item4: Close a job posting by just asking.
interviewsEvaluations.item5: Open several applicants' profiles at once in the chat, including their phone, email and resume when you need them, and see who's phone-verified.
interviewsEvaluations.item6: Every assistant reply now shows a copy button and the real time/tokens it took to answer.

smarterAssistantExcel.title: A smarter assistant and Excel export
smarterAssistantExcel.item1: Ask the assistant about your applicants and it looks up the real answer — who's shortlisted, how many applied from Kuala Lumpur, your top matches and where each one stands, one person's skills and experience, who hasn't replied to an interview invite, or when a posting expires. In English or Malay.
smarterAssistantExcel.item2: Hiring managers and panel members only ever get answers about the postings and candidates they can already see.
smarterAssistantExcel.item3: Export applicants to Excel from the Applicants page or any posting's page — exactly the list you've filtered to. Or just ask the assistant to "export it to Excel".
smarterAssistantExcel.item4: Exports leave out email addresses and phone numbers, to keep applicants' contact details safe.
smarterAssistantExcel.item5: AI suggestions are more dependable, with a backup ready if one AI service is slow.
smarterAssistantExcel.item6: The chat bar now lives in your dashboard after you sign in, rather than on the public home page.

guidesDashboard.title: Clearer guides and a smoother dashboard
guidesDashboard.item1: New "How it works" guides on the Team and Advertisement pages, explaining team roles and invites, and how company and job ads are booked, reviewed and run.
guidesDashboard.item2: Collapse the dashboard sidebar to icons for more room — it remembers your choice on this device.
guidesDashboard.item3: Dashboard tiles like "New applicants" or "Needs evaluation" now open Applicants or Interviews already filtered to those people.
guidesDashboard.item4: When you click a sidebar item, it shows a small spinner while the page loads, so you know it's on its way.
guidesDashboard.item5: Pages load faster when lots of people visit at the same time.
guidesDashboard.item6: Seasonal themes now carry through to the colour of the employer page's feature sections.

legalPages.title: About, release notes, and legal pages
legalPages.item1: New pages in the footer: About, Release notes, Privacy, Security, and Terms & Conditions.
legalPages.item2: Fixed a mobile scrolling glitch where overscrolling past the top or bottom briefly showed a plain white background.

workLocationsCertificates.title: Applicants' preferred work locations and certification files
workLocationsCertificates.item1: Applicant profiles now show the towns and areas they'd like to work in, picked from a real place search.
workLocationsCertificates.item2: Certifications & licenses can include the actual certificate or license file — open it straight from an applicant's profile.
workLocationsCertificates.item3: More reliable Google sign-in and file uploads after a server restart.

directoryVideoPitch.item3: A Resume Designer to turn a jobseeker's profile into a clean, downloadable resume.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This explains what JobGiga collects, why, and what you can do about it. It applies whether you're hiring or job hunting.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.b1: Account basics from sign-in: your name, email and profile photo.
collect.b2: Jobseeker profiles: resume, work history, education, skills, phone number, location, certifications, and an optional video pitch.
collect.b3: Employer profiles: company details, the SSM registration document you upload for verification, and your team members' details.
collect.b4: What you do on JobGiga: job postings viewed, applications submitted, and basic device/browser info, kept for security and to fix problems.

use.heading: How we use it
use.b1: To match jobseekers with postings and let employers review who applied.
use.b2: To verify a phone number with a one-time code, sent by text or call.
use.b3: To read a resume and fill in a profile for you, and to power the AI assistant and cover-letter writer — your content is sent to our AI service provider to generate that one response, not used to train their models.
use.b4: To send account emails: verification codes, application updates, team invites.

share.heading: Who we share it with
share.p1: An employer sees a jobseeker's full profile once that person applies to one of their postings — never before. We don't sell personal data.
share.b1: A sign-in provider, to let you sign in without JobGiga handling your password.
share.b2: A messaging provider, to send the phone verification code.
share.b3: An email provider, to send account emails.
share.b4: An AI service provider, to parse resumes and power AI features, as above.

storage.heading: Where it's kept
storage.p1: Uploaded files (resumes, avatars, certifications, company logos, job posters) are stored on our servers behind access controls. Video pitches and AI interview recordings are kept separately and are only reachable through a permission check — never a public link.

retention.heading: How long we keep it
retention.p1: We keep your data while your account is active. AI interview recordings are kept for 30 days and then deleted automatically. An employer can delete their company account from Company Profile, which removes its data; if you'd like your jobseeker account and its data removed, contact us and we'll take care of it.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.p1: You can review and update most of your information yourself from your profile. For anything else — a copy of your data, a correction, or deleting your account — contact us using the details below.

children.heading: Children
children.p1: JobGiga is for people old enough to legally work in Malaysia, and isn't intended for children.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: If this policy changes in a way that matters, we'll update the date at the top and let you know.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.p1: Questions about this policy or your data? Reach us at the contact details on our Company Profile, or through the AI assistant.

security.title: Security
security.intro: How JobGiga protects your account and the data in it.

signIn.heading: Signing in
signIn.p1: Sign-in goes through a trusted sign-in provider — JobGiga never sees or stores your password. For an extra layer where it matters (like a phone number on your profile), we verify it with a one-time code rather than trusting what's typed in.

session.heading: Your session
session.p1: Once you're signed in, your session is a short-lived, signed cookie — not something a page's own code can read or tamper with. It's checked on every request that touches your account or data.

data.heading: Your data in transit and at rest
data.p1: Traffic between your browser and JobGiga is encrypted (HTTPS). Files you upload — resumes, avatars, certifications, company documents — are stored behind access controls, not exposed publicly by default. Video pitches and AI interview recordings go a step further: they're only reachable through a permission check tied to your account, so a guessed or shared link can't reach them.

access.heading: Who can see what
access.p1: An employer only sees a jobseeker's profile once that person has actually applied to one of their postings. Within a company, team roles (owner, hiring manager, panel) decide who can edit a posting, see applicants, or just sit on an interview panel — not everyone on a team automatically sees everything.

platform.heading: Keeping the platform itself secure
platform.p1: We apply security updates to the systems JobGiga runs on, and changes to the product go through review before they ship. If you believe you've found a security issue, please tell us rather than testing it against real accounts or data — see Contact below.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.p1: Found a security problem, or have a question about how something's protected? Reach us at the contact details on our Company Profile, or through the AI assistant.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: The basics of using JobGiga, for employers and jobseekers alike.

using.heading: Using JobGiga
using.p1: You need an account to post jobs or apply to them. You're responsible for keeping your sign-in secure and for what happens under your account — tell us if you think someone else has access to it.

posting.heading: What you post
posting.b1: Job postings must describe a real role you're genuinely hiring for, with accurate pay, requirements and location.
posting.b2: Your profile, resume and any documents you upload (including an SSM registration document) must be accurate and belong to you or your company.
posting.b3: No discriminatory, misleading or illegal postings or profile content.

ai.heading: AI features
ai.p1: JobGiga uses AI to parse resumes, draft job postings, write cover letters and power the assistant. It's a drafting tool, not a decision-maker — review anything it produces before relying on it, and you're responsible for what you ultimately post or submit.

verification.heading: Company verification
verification.p1: Employers may be asked to upload an SSM registration document so we can verify the company is real. A badge on a verified company reflects that we checked this document — it isn't an endorsement of the company or any posting it makes.

prohibited.heading: What you can't do
prohibited.b1: Scrape, copy or resell data from JobGiga.
prohibited.b2: Impersonate a company or person you're not.
prohibited.b3: Try to access another account or data you're not meant to see.
prohibited.b4: Use the platform to do anything illegal under Malaysian law.

removal.heading: Accounts and postings we may remove
removal.p1: We may remove a posting, suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, without it affecting anyone else's use of JobGiga.

noGuarantee.heading: No guarantee of a hire or a job
noGuarantee.p1: JobGiga helps employers and jobseekers find each other — it doesn't guarantee a hire, an interview, or a job offer. Hiring decisions are always the employer's own.

changes.heading: Changes to these terms
changes.p1: If these terms change in a way that matters, we'll update the date at the top and let you know.

law.heading: Governing law
law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Malaysia.

contact.heading: Contact us
contact.p1: Questions about these terms? Reach us at the contact details on our Company Profile, or through the AI assistant.
